verdict.rationale: Muse's Goals tab, activity log, and approval-card workflow (muse-docs-5, muse-docs-8, muse-docs-13) show first-party support for autonomous background task tracking and execution, and muse-docs-7 explicitly describes agents building tools for unattended tasks. However, an independent hands-on stress test found the agent's control plane starts timing out under load, exposing concrete failure points in its background-automation architecture (muse-comm-1), directly undercutting reliability claims for autonomous operation. missing for 10: independent confirmation that background automations run reliably at scale, more detail on scheduling/triggering mechanisms for autonomous runs.
